flow: Confirm selects one empty slot/request, source-builds a detached profile, saves and reloads it, validates the full projection, and publishes once into the caller's shared CharacterState.
Confirm returns to menu_StartGame; it does not invoke start_same_state or create a gameplay receipt.
StartGame repeats assignment for the exact selected slot and passes the exact same CharacterState shared owner plus selected difficulty to the start callback.
Only successful Navigator StartGame delivery produces generic_gameplay_started with the exact shared state, selected slot and save path identity.
Existing-profile Start reads only the path returned for the exact selected slot through load_character; missing/corrupt files fail without create fallback or state publication.
native_separation: Generic start receipts do not satisfy FrontendRuntimeResultV1::gameplay_ready(), do not carry CanonicalCharacterCandidateRecordV60, and are not native StartGame/InitPost receipts.

tests.focused_result: PASS 2/2; Confirm staging without start, delayed StartGame, same state/control-block and save identity, explicit existing file, missing file no-fallback, generic/native result separation

root_dependencies: Construct RuntimeCreationFlowServicesV1 from root's actual source data, caller shared CharacterState, true empty-slot request/path selector, selected-existing-slot path provider, same-slot assignment provider, and same-state start provider.
Set FrontendRunConfigV1.selected_slot from the real selected slot/in-use state.
Root owns main/CMake callsite and platform asset/service pin wiring.
